layer0_head0: Pancreas Cells & Expression : This head has increased attention on genes related to pancreas ductal and acinar cells, as well as genes with higher expression, or related to GOMF identical protein binding.

This head focuses on gene expression and is positively associated with processes related to cell adhesion and cytoskeleton organization, while negatively associated with interspecies interactions and immune defense responses.
layer0_head2:
Head Name: Regulation of Metabolic Processes

This head focuses on genes with higher expression involved in the regulation of metabolic processes, including both biosynthesis and RNA metabolism.
layer0_head3:
Head Name: Stress Response & Cell Cycle

layer0_head4:
Head Name: Stress Response & Respiratory Morphology

This head focuses on genes involved in the cellular response to stress and abnormal respiratory system morphology, with decreased attention to DNA binding and plasma membrane components.

This head increases attention to genes with higher expression and positively regulates biosynthetic processes while reducing focus on cell cycle and plasma membrane components.
